newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BK Vision UBS stake at 9.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: BK Vision UBS stake at 9.2 pct.

text.p: Investment trust BK Vision said the composition of its portfolio was virtually unchanged at end- August and that it held 9.2 percent of Union Bank of Switzerland's (UBS) registered shares and 5.5 percent of its bearer stock.
Bk Vision, controlled by Swiss financier Martin Ebner, is UBS's largest single shareholder.

The trust said in its interim report that it held slightly more than two million registered shares and 1.18 million bearer shares. The UBS holdings amounted to approximately 1.9 billion Swiss francs, or 70.3 percent of the BK Vision portfolio.
Separately, BK said its stake in Zurich Insurance Co did not appreciably change during the period either.
The stake amounted to almost 800 million francs, accounting for 29.7 percent of the BK portfolio at the end of August. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
